**Quick 10‑minute tee slogans**

1. **“Wear the vibe, not the size.”**  
   (Ideal for the “Feel‑Good” line – the message is all about how clothing should make you feel, not fit perfectly straight away.)

2. **“Bold. Bright. Un‑stoppable.”**  
   (Great on sports‑wear or street‑wear tees – it’s a short, punchy call‑to‑action that works as a hook on the front and back.)

3. **“Every thread tells a story.”**  
   (Perfect for the eco‑friendly [or artisanal] line – it invites customers to imagine the life of the tee and encourages mindful purchasing.)

Feel free to mix the wording, flip the order on front/back or add a small graphic. Happy printing!
